Which first 20-30 slices best cover algebra, calculus, linear algebra, graph equivalents, dashboard rows, generated problem hooks, and flashcard hooks without overbroad visual polishing.
Whether the proposed run contract has small enough commit boundaries for future autonomous execution.
allowedWork: Create a proposed long-loop run contract for symbolic manipulation animation-library expansion.

Keep the loop focused on typed family schemas, semantic transformations, runtime/visual samples, graph equivalents, law checks, dashboard rows, generated problem hooks, flashcard hooks, and closeout reporting.
